anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Before the abrupt transition, system pressure was 649.409 mbar, column differential pressure 0.980 mbar, and buffer differential pressure 1.989 mbar.
System pressure abruptly fell to 392.310 mbar, column differential pressure fell to 0.381 mbar, and buffer differential pressure rose to 6.896 mbar.
The changed pressure regime persists: 400.862, 0.339, and 6.481 mbar, respectively.
Distillate flow remains near zero at 0.006 while reflux is 1.286, versus 0.331 and 0.338 at t=1080 s.
Reboiler and upper-column temperatures fell to 64.818 and 32.823 °C from 73.605 and 43.914 °C at t=1080 s, corroborating a physical process transition.
Heater readings are markedly discrepant at 374.912 and 80.529 °C; independent verification is needed before interpreting this as overheating or a sensor fault.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol phase and commanded pressure/reflux changes are needed to exclude an intentional transition; vacuum and valve status, independent pressure and heater-temperature checks are needed to identify a fault. No composition measurement or separation target has been supplied.
